marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 365 天思考致富 : 啟動意念的力量, 活出自己的人生 | 365 tian si kao zhi fu : qi dong yi nian de li liang, huo chu zi ji de ren sheng

Think and Grow Rich is not just about making money—it's about much more. Every person who has truly lived life on their own terms started with one thing: a clear goal. But how exactly do we harness the power of thought? This book sets out to answer that question. When it was first published in 1937, the United States was in the midst of the longest and most severe economic depression in its history. Napoleon Hill hoped the power of thought could spread to every corner of society—helping those devastated by the Great Depression, the unemployed, and the bankrupt find the strength to rebuild and rise again. Over the decades, this book has inspired countless minds and generations. Before choosing to "opt out" of the hustle in the 21st century, why not give yourself another chance? Read and apply the 13 principles of success distilled by the “Father of Success Literature,” Napoleon Hill—drawn from 25 years of research and interviews with over 500 successful individuals. Try it for yourself: can the positive thoughts you project manifest into the abundant reality described by the hundreds of achievers in this timeless classic?
